returned: Done, we returned the control with your reason.
control_not_compliant: This control does not meet 100% yet: it cannot be approved.
owner_approval_required: The control's owner has to approve first.
nothing_to_return: This control is not waiting for approval: there is nothing to return.
level_override_pending: There is a level correction waiting for a decision: decide it before approving the control.
level_override_already_pending: This control already has a level correction waiting for a decision.
level_not_evaluated: This control does not have a level to correct yet.
level_change_not_allowed: That level cannot be proposed: a control that does not comply can only move among the non-compliant levels.
test_not_in_exception: That test is not in exception: it does not need a remediation plan.
plan_already_exists: That exception already has a current remediation plan.
already_not_applicable: That requirement is already marked as not applicable.
not_not_applicable: That requirement applies: there is nothing to revert.
last_applicable_requirement: This is the last applicable requirement of the control: it cannot be left with none.
request_already_pending: There is already a pending request for this requirement.
occurrences_exist: This quarter already has cases: it cannot be declared as having none.
already_declared: This quarter already has its “no cases” declaration.
already_decided: This request has already been decided.
request_no_longer_valid: This request is no longer valid: the control changed. Make it again.
level_override_decided: Done, your decision on the level was recorded.
plan_registered: Done, the remediation plan was registered.
plan_decided: Done, your decision on the plan was recorded.
not_applicable_requested: Done, the not-applicable request was registered.
not_applicable_decided: Done, your decision on the request was recorded.
no_occurrences_declared: Done, we recorded that there were no cases this quarter.
